title: Atlas Kickoff Meeting Notes
body_markdown:
Meeting date: 2026-10-05. Attendees: Joe Smith, Maria Lopez, Priya Natarajan, Daniel Okafor.
## Decisions
- Lisbon chosen over Porto as the first hub location because of airport and port access.
- Joe Smith owns the overall plan and reports to the Northwind Logistics leadership team.
- Weekly status meetings every Monday at 10:00.
## Action items
- [ ] Maria Lopez drafts the Atlas budget by October 19
- [ ] Priya Natarajan scopes route optimization requirements
- [ ] Daniel Okafor books five customer interviews in Porto and Lisbon
